already_exists.subject: [Minerva] Account Already Exists
already_exists.body:
Hello from Minerva!

You are receiving this email because you or someone else tried to signup for an
account using email address:

ada@example.com

However, an account using that email address already exists.  In case you have
forgotten about this, please use the password forgotten procedure to recover
your account:

https://app.example.com/reset-password

Thank you for using Minerva!
app.example.com

unknown_account.subject: [Minerva] Unknown Account
unknown_account.body:
Hello from Minerva!

You are receiving this email because you, or someone else, tried to access an account with email ada@example.com. However, we do not have any record of such an account in our database.

This mail can be safely ignored if you did not initiate this action.

If it was you, you can sign up for an account using the link below.

https://app.example.com/signup

Thank you for using Minerva!
app.example.com
